title: Danger zone
body: Resetting clears runs, traces and learnings for this workspace. Agents and skills are kept. This cannot be undone.
runHistoryNote: Run history includes reviews, findings and Agent Performance data.

reset.label: Reset run history
reset.nameUnavailable: The workspace name has not loaded, so run history cannot be reset yet.

dialog.title: Reset run history?
dialog.intro: This permanently deletes the run history of this workspace.

deleted.runs: {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} with their reviews, findings and traces
deleted.runsUnknown: Runs with their reviews, findings and traces
deleted.other: Eval runs, CI runs and composed reviews

kept.config: Agents, skills, eval cases, repositories and settings
kept.pulls: Pull requests, which are marked as not reviewed again

dialog.exportNote: Export does not include run history, so an export is not a backup of what is deleted here.
dialog.spendNote: This month's spend total will no longer include the deleted runs.
dialog.reasonMismatch: The button stays disabled until the text matches the workspace name exactly.
dialog.done: Run history reset: {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}, {findings, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} and {learnings, plural, one {# learning} other {# learnings}} deleted.
